summary: Queue the spec-defined PerformanceObserver task and invoke interested observers asynchronously with drained entry lists.

semantics.delivery: copies and empties observer buffer before callback
semantics.callback_throw: reported by host without restoring drained buffer

caveats: Do not lower observer delivery to direct delegate invocation.

tests.name: callback later than mark call
tests.input: let order=[]; const o=new PerformanceObserver(()=>order.push('cb')); o.observe({type:'mark'}); performance.mark('x'); order.push('sync'); setTimeout(()=>console.log(order[0]),0);

tests.name: queued entries may batch
tests.expected_behavior: delivery can batch queued entries rather than synchronously invoking once per mark
